_comment: Captured from listProjects/listSessions through the public client at 3db39a7, before the catalog existed, on the committed small/small-codex/small-grok fixture corpus. Identity fields derive from the temp root path and so vary per run; they are normalized to their stable native keys. Regenerate only when the history contract deliberately changes. `lastCommitSeq` is omitted: it is a watermark whose absolute value shifts whenever the number of commits in the database changes, and the catalog adds one commit per source. The test asserts its actual contract — positive and no greater than the page watermark — instead. getOverview, search, and listMemoryDocuments were captured the same way at the same commit; their rows have run-varying identity and ingest bookkeeping removed.
